title: Great tour. Fantastic day.
text: What a wonderful tour. Pedro, our transfer driver met us at our cruise ship, it was so easy. He was prompt, kind, helpful and went out of his way to show us as much of the area as he could. Sol was our guide at Alhambra and was the best! So knowledgeable and the nicest guy. Thoroughly recommend this tour. Five star!
author: alisondF59OG

title: Did a great job, very professional!
text: Driving team was great and accomodating.  Guide was well versed and knowledgeable. Overall great experience.
author: Q6862AWchriss

title: I'd do this differently next time
text: We got off to a bad start in communicating with the driver as he was actually inside the port and the ship told us we had to take the bus to the tourist center.  But we worked it out and the driver (actually a taxi) drove us to the site - about an hour each way.  We had a private tour guide who walked us through the Alhambra site and was very knowledgeable (I think his name was Pedro - will update if I find the pic I took).  Then we returned to the ship.  All that said, this was a very expensive tour and I might have been able to do it less expensively - not sure what we got was worth the pric
author: Karen_H
